en.name: AquaStep: Walk to Hatch Fish
en.tagline: Walk to hatch, breed rare mythic fish & unwind with Lo-Fi ambient soundscapes.
en.promo: Turn your daily steps into a serene underwater sanctuary. Sync with Apple Health to hatch 1,176 species, discover 146 secret genetic mutation recipes, focus with ambient Lo-Fi water sounds, and trade fish peer-to-peer via Apple Multipeer without servers.
features: Apple HealthKit Integration — Hatch fish eggs effortlessly with your daily walking steps & calorie burn
1,176-Species Vault — From Japanese Tancho Koi and Amazon plecos to abyssal creatures and cosmic star leviathans
Anatomy-Accurate Pixel Art — Dedicated species silhouettes: koi barbels, seahorse tails, jellyfish bells, anglerfish lures and flowing dorsal fins
Secret Genetic Breeding Lab — Crossbreed adult pairs across 146 rare mutation recipes
Lo-Fi Focus & White Noise — Original ambient water soundscapes and Pomodoro timer for stress-free focus & sleep
Serverless P2P Nearby Trade — Tap & trade rare fish directly with nearby friends using Apple Multipeer Connectivity
iOS 17+ Interactive & Lock Screen Widgets — Tap to feed directly from your Home Screen, monitor egg step progress on Lock Screen, and sync with iCloud
36 Achievements — 4 categories (Collection / Action / Breeding / Interaction), passive no-daily-reset tracking + 3 exclusive achievement-only decor items

qa.q: Do I need to keep the app open to track steps?
qa.a: No — TinyAquarium reads your steps in the background via Apple HealthKit and CoreMotion. Walk normally and your eggs will continue to hatch.

qa.q: How does Nearby Trade work?
qa.a: It uses Apple Multipeer Connectivity over local Bluetooth and Wi-Fi. No accounts, no servers, and 100% private.

qa.q: Does crossbreeding consume my adult fish?
qa.a: No — adult parent fish stay in your tank and continue swimming happily after breeding.

qa.q: Is my data stored on the cloud?
qa.a: Your progress syncs seamlessly across your iPhone, iPad and Mac using Apple iCloud Key-Value Store.

qa.q: Which devices are supported?
qa.a: Supports iPhone and iPad running iOS 17.0 or later, and Mac.

zh-hant.name: 走路水族館：步數孵蛋的療癒水族箱
zh-hant.tagline: 走路步數孵化、基因繁育千種神魚，沈浸於 Lo-Fi 水聲的療癒水族箱。
zh-hant.promo: 把每一步的健康步伐，化作掌心靈動的治癒深海。連動 Apple HealthKit 步數孵化破殼、探索 1,176 種全球水族與山海經星空神魚、解鎖 146 組秘密基因突變繁育、在 Lo-Fi 白噪音中沉浸專注，並透過 iOS 互動桌面與鎖定畫面小組件隨時守護。
features: Apple HealthKit 步數連動 — 日常健走每一步都在為水族箱注入生命活力，加速魚卵孵化
1,176 種全水域神魚圖鑑 — 涵蓋東亞江戶名門、亞馬遜狂野黑水、大堡礁珊瑚、萬米深淵至山海經與宇宙星宿
解剖級像素外觀 — 錦鯉龍鬚、海龍馬尾、水母鐘體、鮟鱇引燈與流體擺動背鰭，每個魚種都有專屬輪廓
秘密基因繁育實驗室 — 將成年親代放入繁育室，探索 146 組隱藏突變配方
Lo-Fi 專注番茄鐘與水聲白噪音 — 原創深海平靜曲目與環境音效，助你高效工作與放鬆入眠
無伺服器近場 P2P 神魚交易 — 透過 Apple Multipeer 免註冊秒速近場交換珍稀魚卵，極致隱私安全
iOS 17+ 互動桌面與鎖定畫面 Widget — 支援桌面一鍵投餵，鎖定畫面即時查看孵蛋步數與水族動態
36 條成就系統 — 收集／行動／繁育進化／互動四組，純被動累計無每日重置，含 3 件限定成就飾品（商城不賣）

qa.q: 需要一直開啟 App 才能記錄步數嗎？
qa.a: 完全不需要！TinyAquarium 透過 Apple HealthKit 與 CoreMotion 系統後台自動讀取步數，日常通勤走路即可持續累積孵化進度。

qa.q: 近場神魚交易（P2P Trade）需要網路嗎？
qa.a: 不需要外部網際網路！只要兩台裝置在數公尺內，打開藍牙與 Wi-Fi，即可透過 Apple Multipeer 點對點加密直連交換。

qa.q: 基因繁育會消耗掉親代魚嗎？
qa.a: 不會！繁育完成後親代魚依然會在水族箱中自由游動，僅消耗一次繁育次數與愛心能量。

qa.a: 支援！透過 Apple iCloud 雲端鍵值儲存（KVS），進度會自動無縫備份與同步至你的 iPhone、iPad 與 Mac。

qa.q: 支援哪些裝置？
qa.a: 支援運行 iOS 17.0+ 的 iPhone、iPad 與 Mac。

en.name: Web to PPT (Editable)
en.tagline: Turn AI-generated HTML slides into a truly editable PowerPoint — 100% on-device.

en.name: TinyWalk
en.tagline: Generate step count & health test data on iPhone and Android, for developers testing HealthKit and Health Connect apps.
en.promo: Generate realistic HealthKit step and workout samples on-device, in seconds. No account needed.
features: Generate realistic step count & workout samples

On Android, writes steps, distance and exercise sessions to Health Connect
Pick the sample shape: one sample per session, or a per-minute split in an HKWorkout

qa.q: What does this app actually do?
qa.a: TinyWalk is a tool for developers and QA testers: it generates structurally correct step and health test data on your own iPhone, so you can verify apps that read this kind of data.

qa.q: Where does the generated data show up?
qa.a: It's written directly into the Health app, tagged as coming from TinyWalk, and can be deleted anytime from the Health app.

qa.q: Is the data real?
qa.a: No — it's synthetic test data for your development workflow, not a record of real activity.

qa.q: Does it cost anything?
qa.a: The 100-step and 1,000-step datasets are free forever. Unlocking 2,000+ step datasets is a one-time purchase, no subscription.

qa.q: Can I control how the samples are written?
qa.a: Yes. Sample Shape writes a session either as one step sample covering the whole window, or split into per-minute samples bundled in an HKWorkout — so you can exercise both paths your app might take. Whether distance is written alongside, and whether samples are tagged user-entered or device-recorded, are separate switches.

qa.q: Another app doesn't count the steps TinyWalk wrote — why?
qa.a: TinyWalk writes synthetic step data to the Health app. Whether other apps read that data, and how they count it, is up to each app and outside our control. TinyWalk is not supported for any use where steps earn rewards. If the steps don't appear in the Health app itself, check in iOS Settings that TinyWalk still has write access to Health data (worth re-checking after an iOS update), then let us know via Settings → Report a Problem in the app.

qa.q: How do I add the keyboard?
qa.a: Open iPhone Settings › General › Keyboard › Keyboards › Add New Keyboard…, then choose TinyKeyboard under Other iPhone Keyboards. In any text field, tap the globe key to switch to it.

qa.q: Why does the keyboard ask for 'Allow Full Access'? What works without it?
qa.a: Zhuyin and English typing work without it. Full Access lets the keyboard read the phrases, barcodes, stickers, emoji favorites and custom roots you saved in the app (shared through an App Group on your iPhone), copy stickers and barcode images to the clipboard when you tap them, and record for voice input. The keyboard does not record your keystrokes or send anything over the internet. See the Privacy Policy.

qa.q: How do I use the four-square key?
qa.a: While typing, tap the four-square key at the bottom left. Pick Carrier, Phrases, Stickers or Emoji. Tapping a phrase, barcode number or emoji inserts it; tapping a sticker or long-pressing a barcode copies it, so touch and hold the text field and choose Paste.

qa.q: How do I add a carrier or membership barcode?
qa.a: In the TinyKeyboard app, open Tools, then tap Scan Barcode to use the camera, or Add Barcode to type one in. The app stores up to 30 barcodes.

qa.q: How do I turn on custom root input?
qa.a: In the app, open Settings › Keyboard Settings, then import a .dict.yaml root table or add entries in My Roots first. Then turn on Custom Root Input. The keyboard's input-mode menu will then include the root mode.

qa.q: How does voice input work?
qa.a: Turn on Full Access, tap Voice Input on the keyboard, press the microphone, speak, and press it again to finish. It uses Apple's on-device recognition by default. For the Whisper model, open Settings › Voice Input in the app and turn on Advanced Recognition; the first download is about 646 MB and it then needs roughly 8 minutes to optimize for your iPhone.

qa.a: 打開 iPhone「設定」›「一般」›「鍵盤」›「鍵盤」›「新增鍵盤⋯」，在「其他 iPhone 鍵盤」選「小抽屜鍵盤」。在任何輸入框按地球鍵就能切換過去。

qa.a: 不開也能用注音與英文打字。開啟後，鍵盤才讀得到你在 App 裡存的常用語、條碼、貼圖、表情收藏與自訂字根（透過你手機上的 App Group 共用），才能在你點選時把貼圖與條碼圖片複製到剪貼簿，也才能使用語音輸入的錄音。鍵盤不會記錄你打的字，也不會連網傳送任何東西。詳見隱私權政策。

qa.q: What Google data does TinyKanban access, and why?
qa.a: TinyKanban asks for access to Google Tasks so it can read, create, edit, complete, and delete your tasks and task lists. It also asks for your email address and basic profile, used only to show which Google account is signed in. TinyKanban does not send this data to any other server.

qa.q: Why does Google show an "unverified app" warning when I sign in?
qa.a: Google is still reviewing TinyKanban for verification. Until the review is done, Google shows a warning when you sign in. To continue, choose "Advanced", then "Go to TinyKanban". The app asks only for the access listed above. When Google approves the app, the warning goes away, and you do not need to update anything.

qa.q: Does TinyKanban store my tasks on a server?
qa.a: No. TinyKanban has no server of its own. It talks directly to Google, and your tasks stay in your Google account.

qa.q: Does it work offline?
qa.a: No. TinyKanban loads and saves tasks through the Google Tasks API, so it needs an internet connection.

qa.q: Why can't I delete a task assigned from Google Docs or Chat?
qa.a: Deleting one through the Google Tasks API also deletes the original in Docs or Chat. Open the task at its source and unassign it there first.

qa.q: 登入時 Google 顯示「未經驗證的應用程式」警告，正常嗎？
qa.a: 正常。Google 還在審核 TinyKanban 的驗證，審核完成前登入時會顯示這個警告。要繼續，請點「進階」，再點「前往 TinyKanban」。App 只會要求上面列出的權限。Google 核准後警告會自動消失，你不需要更新任何東西。

qa.a: 不會。TinyKanban 沒有自己的伺服器，直接與 Google 連線，任務都留在你的 Google 帳號。

qa.q: 可以離線使用嗎？
qa.a: 不行。TinyKanban 透過 Google Tasks API 讀取和儲存任務，需要網路連線。

qa.q: 為什麼不能刪除來自 Google 文件或 Chat 的指派任務？
